setting.help: How demands and orders are priced.
setting.div: An outlet pays MRP less its own margin %. A distributor pays MRP less its own margin %. A product with no MRP, or a contact with no margin, keeps the product price. Example: MRP 200, distributor 30%, outlet 10% - the distributor buys at 140 and sells at 180 (profit 40); the outlet sells at 200 (profit 20).

setting.help: Used for a distributor that has no margin of its own. Where an outlet is given a bigger margin than its distributor has, the company makes the distributor good with a debit note.
